alreadyRunningElsewhere: WWlogs is already running in another Windows session or on another desktop. Only one WWlogs can run at a time for each Windows user.
notResponding: WWlogs is already running but is not responding. Wait a moment and try again. If it still does not respond, end WWlogs in Task Manager and start it again.
checkFailed: WWlogs could not check whether it is already running, so it did not start. Try again. If this keeps happening, restart Windows.
